metaDescription: Install .pkg packages from the local server straight to the PS4 via Remote Package Installer.
title: Packages in /packages
subtitle: Pick a .pkg file and the console downloads it straight from the local server via Remote Package Installer. Requires Debug Settings enabled on the PS4.
emptyBody: Put the .pkg files in the packages/ folder next to index.html. If the server doesn't list directories, add packages/packages.php — it generates the list automatically on every request.
infoBody: On the console, enable Settings → Debug Settings → Game → Package Installer → Remote Package Install (the service listens on port 12800). Sending is “fire and forget”: the page can't read the console's reply, so follow the progress in Notifications / Download list on the PS4.
needHost: Fill in the console's IP before installing.
diagEmpty: empty list (no .pkg files seen in the folder)
diagNoLinks: the received page has no .pkg links (autoindex disabled or index.html in the folder)
